Our story

4.9 stars · 455 reviews · Whitechapel, East London

On Cable Street, a short walk from Shadwell and Whitechapel stations, Toni and Luci have built one of East London's best-loved barbershops.

The numbers tell the story: 4.9 stars across 455 reviews. Behind them is a simple approach — listen first, cut with care, and charge a fair price. A full haircut is £24; add a wash and style for £27; beard trims are just £8.

Book your chair ahead, or walk in when you're passing. Either way, you'll leave sharper than you came in.
